description: Shares the spreadsheet (Drive permissions on the file — the OAuth token needs a Drive scope; the spreadsheets scope alone gets 403 here while every Sheets tool still works). action=list shows who has access: id, type, role, emailAddress/domain per permission; one page per call (shared-drive files cap a page at 100) — when the reply carries nextPageToken, pass it back as page_token for the rest. action=grant gives role reader/commenter/writer to type user/group (email_address required), domain (domain required, e.g. "example.com") or anyone (makes the link public — use deliberately); send_notification_email (default true for users) and email_message control the notification, allow_file_discovery lets domain/anyone grants surface in search. action=update changes an existing permission's role (permission_id + role). action=revoke removes a permission (permission_id) — the person loses access immediately. Ownership transfer is not supported by this server. Protecting individual ranges from co-editors is manage_protected_ranges, not this tool.

action.description: What to do with the file's permissions.

allow_file_discovery.description: grant (domain/anyone): let the file appear in search results (default false).

email_message.description: grant: custom text for the notification email.

page_size.description: list: max permissions per page (1..100; shared-drive files default to 100).

page_token.description: list: nextPageToken from the previous page.

permission_id.description: update/revoke: the permission's id from action=list (or the grant reply).

role.description: grant/update: the access level to give.

send_notification_email.description: grant: send the standard sharing notification (default true for users/groups).

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<spreadsheetId>/edit) or from create_spreadsheet / search_spreadsheets output.

name: manage_permissions
title: Manage spreadsheet access
